name: AKcelerateHQ Lead Generation Engine - Linked Google Form + Sheet

parameters.content:
## AKcelerateHQ Lead Generation Engine - LINKED

This workflow is updated for your actual Google Form + response Sheet.

### 1. Free Audit Auto-Proposal
Google Form / Google Sheets lead → lead score → HTML email proposal → WhatsApp proposal → proposal log → internal alert.

### 2. WhatsApp AI Lead Chatbot
Incoming WhatsApp message → AI assistant qualifies the lead → sends WhatsApp reply through Wassenger.

Linked Sheet:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID/edit

Linked Form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/YOUR_GOOGLE_FORM_ID/viewform

Important: If your response tab name is not "Form responses 1", select the correct tab in the Google Sheets Trigger node.

## Security Notice

This workflow is now linked to your Google Form response Sheet.

Sheet ID:
YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID

Form URL:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/YOUR_GOOGLE_FORM_ID/viewform

Still replace manually inside n8n:
- Google Sheets credentials
- Gmail credentials
- OpenAI credentials
- PASTE_WASSENGER_API_TOKEN_HERE

Do not commit real tokens, OAuth client secrets, customer data, or private credentials to GitHub.

## WhatsApp AI Chatbot Flow

Webhook receives inbound WhatsApp message from Wassenger.

AI Agent replies as AKcelerateHQ assistant and qualifies the lead.

Use this for:
- website WhatsApp button
- inbound lead conversations
- free audit qualification
- pricing and discovery call guidance

options.systemMessage:
You are the official WhatsApp assistant for AKcelerateHQ.

AKcelerateHQ is an AI workflow automation agency that helps businesses automate leads, replies, follow-ups, CRM updates, dashboards, reports, and repetitive manual work.

Contact:
Website: akceleratehq.com
Email: hello@akceleratehq.com
Phone: +91 XXXXX XXXXX

Pricing:
First-time audit and consultation is free.
Builder starts from ₹15,000 / $180 one-time.
Maintenance starts from ₹5,000 / $60 per month per workflow.
Maintenance includes 1 free consultation monthly.
Builder + yearly Maintenance gets 17% discount with minimum 3 months payment upfront.
Enterprise pricing is custom.

Your goal is to qualify leads and guide them toward a free automation audit.

Ask for:
Name, business name, industry, phone, email, website/social link, task they want to automate, tools they use, monthly lead volume, budget, and timeline.

Do not ask all questions at once.
Ask 2–3 questions at a time.
Keep replies short, friendly, and business-focused.
Do not promise fixed final pricing before understanding the workflow.
Do not ask for passwords or API keys in chat.
Always explain automation in business language: save time, reply faster, reduce manual work, stop missing leads, improve follow-up, and organize data.

When the lead is interested, say:
"Great. We can start with a free automation audit. Please share your business name, workflow problem, phone number, and preferred time for a call."

parameters.content:
## AKcelerateHQ Free Audit Auto-Proposal System - FIXED

This workflow starts when a new Google Form row is added.

It now correctly creates:
- Clean lead fields
- Lead score and lead type
- Recommended package
- Personalized HTML email proposal
- Premium WhatsApp proposal message
- Proposal log in Google Sheets
- Internal notification

Fix applied: removed broken chatbot AI Agent path that expected webhook data instead of Google Sheet data.

## Setup Required

Before activating:

1. Connect Google Sheets Trigger credential
2. In the trigger, select the correct form response tab
   Default used here: Form responses 1
3. Connect Gmail credential
4. Create a sheet tab named: Proposal Log
5. Replace PASTE_WASSENGER_API_TOKEN_HERE in WhatsApp nodes
6. Test with one new Google Form submission

Your linked Sheet ID is already added:
YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID

Optional:
- Change prices inside the Code node
- Change email design inside the Code node
- Change WhatsApp tone inside the Code node

parameters.content:
## WhatsApp Setup

This fixed workflow uses Wassenger API because your uploaded file already had Wassenger.

Replace in HTTP node URL:
PASTE_WASSENGER_API_TOKEN_HERE

Expected body:
{
  phone: whatsapp_to,
  message: whatsapp_message
}

If you use AiSensy, WATI, Interakt, WAHA, or Meta Cloud API, replace only this HTTP node.

## HTML Email Sending Enabled

The Gmail proposal node is now configured to send `emailType: html`.

Email body comes from:
`={{ $json.email_html }}`

The HTML template is based on your uploaded AKcelerateHQ email design and dynamically fills:
- full_name
- company_name
- industry
- tools_used
- hours_lost
- pain_points
- desired_workflows
- lead_type
- recommended_package

After import, test with one form submission and check the email in Gmail.
